blocks.zh: 第六章：投訴、退貨、疑似偽造藥品與藥品召回
blocks.en: Chapter 6: Complaints, Returns, Suspected Falsified Medicinal Products and Medicinal Product Recalls

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明 GDP 要求對投訴 (complaints)、退貨 (returns)、偽造藥品 (falsified medicinal products) 及召回 (recalls) 四類事件的書面程序要求與核心義務
blocks.en: Explain the written-procedure requirements and core obligations that GDP sets for four types of event: complaints, returns, falsified medicinal products and recalls

blocks.zh: 辨別退貨產品重回銷售庫存 (return to saleable stock) 的四項前提條件，以及冷鏈產品退貨所需的七類溫度證據文件
blocks.en: Identify the four conditions for returning a product to saleable stock, and the seven types of temperature evidence required for returned cold-chain products

blocks.zh: 描述疑似偽造藥品發現後的立即行動順序：暫停銷售、實體隔離、通報主管機關與 MAH
blocks.en: Describe the immediate action sequence once a falsified medicinal product is suspected: stop sales, physically segregate, and notify the competent authority and the MAH

blocks.zh: 說明召回作業的可追溯性要求、召回進度紀錄，以及年度有效性評估的義務
blocks.en: Explain the traceability requirements for recalls, the recall progress records, and the obligation to evaluate effectiveness annually

blocks.zh: 將上述四類事件管理要求連結至 Taiwan CDMO 倉儲作業的實務情境
blocks.en: Link the management requirements for these four event types to practical scenarios in a Taiwan CDMO warehouse

blocks.zh: 6.1 原則 Principle
blocks.en: 6.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 四大事件類別的共同基礎：本節涵蓋 GDP 中最敏感的四類事件，PIC/S PE 011-1 §6.1 為它們設定三個共同基礎：
blocks.en: The common foundation of the four event types: This section covers the four most sensitive event types in GDP. PIC/S PE 011-1 §6.1 sets three common foundations for them:

blocks.zh: 書面程序 (written procedures)：事前建立，不得即興處理
blocks.en: Written procedures: established in advance; events must not be handled ad hoc

blocks.zh: 完整紀錄 (records)：主管機關 (competent authorities) 隨時可調閱
blocks.en: Complete records: available for review by the competent authorities at any time

blocks.zh: 指定人員評估 (designated personnel)：退貨評估需由特定授權人員執行，非第一線倉管自行決定
blocks.en: Designated personnel: returns must be assessed by specifically authorised persons, not decided by front-line warehouse staff on their own

blocks.zh: 供應鏈一致性：偽造藥品的防控需要整個供應鏈的一致應對——製造商、批發商、藥局都必須遵循相同邏輯，任何一環的鬆動都可能使偽藥重回市場。
blocks.en: Consistency across the supply chain: controlling falsified medicines requires a consistent response from the whole supply chain. Manufacturers, wholesalers and pharmacies must all follow the same logic, because a lapse at any one link can let a falsified product back into the market.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把供應鏈想像成一條河流。偽藥就像污染物：只要上游（製造商）或任何中游（批發商）的閘門出現缺口，污染就會流到下游（患者）。GDP §6.1 的「一致性要求」就是要求每一道閘門都用相同標準把關，不能因為「這是別人的問題」而放行。
blocks.en: Think of the supply chain as a river. A falsified medicine is like a pollutant: if there is a gap in the gates upstream (the manufacturer) or at any point midstream (the wholesalers), the contamination flows downstream to the patient. The "consistency requirement" in GDP §6.1 means every gate must be held to the same standard, and nobody can let something through on the grounds that "it is someone else's problem".

blocks.zh: 在倉儲層面，這意味著你的 SOP 不只是自保工具，更是整個防線的一環。
blocks.en: At warehouse level, this means your SOP is not only a way of protecting yourself but also part of the whole line of defence.

blocks.zh: 重要警示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「應提供主管機關調閱」不是「備查即可」：這代表記錄必須即時、完整、可索引。TFDA 稽查時若發現紀錄殘缺或無法追溯，是重大缺失 (major deficiency)。
blocks.en: "Available to the competent authorities" does not mean "keep on file": It means records must be current, complete and indexed. If TFDA finds incomplete or untraceable records during an inspection, this is a major deficiency.

blocks.zh: 指定人員的授權文件：「designated personnel」必須有書面授權依據（通常在 SOP 或品質協議中列名），不能由任何有空閒的人代替執行退貨評估。
blocks.en: Authorisation documents for designated personnel: "Designated personnel" must have a documented basis for their authorisation (usually named in an SOP or quality agreement). Returns assessments cannot be performed by whoever happens to be free.

blocks.zh: 練習問題 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 假設你的倉庫同時收到一批客戶退貨和一通產品投訴電話，§6.1 要求你首先採取哪些共同動作？
blocks.en: Your warehouse receives a customer return and a product complaint call at the same time. Which common actions does §6.1 require you to take first?

blocks.zh: 若公司 SOP 規定「倉管主任」負責退貨評估，但今天主任請假，可否由副主任代理？需要什麼文件支持？
blocks.en: If the company SOP assigns returns assessment to the "warehouse supervisor" but the supervisor is on leave today, can the deputy supervisor stand in? What documentation is needed to support this?

blocks.zh: 6.2 投訴管理 Complaints
blocks.en: 6.2 Complaints

blocks.zh: 投訴分類是關鍵第一步：GDP §6.2.1 要求明確區分：
blocks.en: Classifying the complaint is the critical first step: GDP §6.2.1 requires a clear distinction between:

blocks.zh: 品質投訴 (quality complaint)：涉及產品本身——外觀異常、效價不足、污染等。必須立即通知製造商/MAH，因為可能涉及批次性品質問題。
blocks.en: Quality complaint: concerns the product itself, such as abnormal appearance, insufficient potency or contamination. The manufacturer/MAH must be notified immediately, because a batch-wide quality problem may be involved.

blocks.zh: 配送投訴 (distribution complaint)：涉及物流層面——遲交、包裝損壞（非產品問題）、溫度偏差記錄等。由批發商自行調查。
blocks.en: Distribution complaint: concerns the logistics side, such as late delivery, damaged packaging (not a product problem) or temperature excursion records. The wholesaler investigates it itself.

blocks.zh: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action，糾正與預防措施)：§6.2.4 要求調查後視必要性執行 CAPA，這將投訴管理連結至品質管理系統 (QMS)，確保問題不重複發生。
blocks.en: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action): §6.2.4 requires CAPA to be implemented after investigation where necessary. This links complaint handling to the quality management system (QMS) and helps ensure the problem does not recur.

blocks.zh: 其他批次延伸調查：§6.2.2 的批次延伸原則是 GDP 的重要思維——單一投訴可能是冰山一角，應系統性評估是否為批次性問題。
blocks.en: Extended investigation of other batches: The batch-extension principle in §6.2.2 is an important GDP way of thinking: a single complaint may be the tip of the iceberg, so you should systematically assess whether the problem is batch-related.

blocks.zh: 想像你在便利商店買到一瓶有異味的飲料。如果你客訴門市（=配送投訴），門市會調查是運送途中冷藏失效的問題。但如果你說「這飲料本身就有問題」（=品質投訴），門市必須立即通知製造商，因為同一批次可能有數千瓶在市面上。
blocks.en: Imagine you buy a bottle of drink with an off smell at a convenience store. If you complain to the store (= a distribution complaint), the store investigates whether refrigeration failed during delivery. But if you say "the drink itself is bad" (= a quality complaint), the store must notify the manufacturer immediately, because thousands of bottles from the same batch may be on the market.

blocks.zh: GDP §6.2 的分類邏輯完全相同：誰的問題，找誰負責，速度與範圍不同。
blocks.en: The classification logic in GDP §6.2 is exactly the same: whoever owns the problem is responsible, but speed and scope differ.

blocks.zh: 「立即通知」(without delay) 不是下班後再說：品質投訴若涉及潛在缺陷，通知 MAH 的時效性至關重要。延遲通知可能導致更多問題產品流入市場，主管機關對此有嚴格要求。
blocks.en: "Without delay" does not mean after working hours: For a quality complaint involving a potential defect, the timeliness of notifying the MAH is critical. Delayed notification can allow more defective product to reach the market, and the competent authorities have strict expectations on this.

blocks.zh: 指定投訴負責人 (§6.2.3)：必須有特定人員的書面指定，不能是「大家都可以處理」。在 CDMO 情境下，這通常是品保代表或客服主管，且需要適當的培訓記錄。
blocks.en: Designated complaint handler (§6.2.3): A specific person must be designated in writing; it cannot be "anyone can deal with it". In a CDMO setting this is usually a QA representative or customer service supervisor, with appropriate training records.

blocks.zh: 原始細節的重要性：「all the original details」意味著投訴記錄不能被改寫或整理——原始客戶用語、時間戳記、批號等必須完整保存，以利後續稽查。
blocks.en: The importance of original details: "All the original details" means complaint records must not be rewritten or tidied up. The customer's original wording, timestamps, batch numbers and so on must be preserved in full to support later audits.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 Taiwan CDMO 倉儲情境下：客戶來電反映收到的注射劑外包裝有凹陷，但內包裝完好，產品未受損。
blocks.en: In a Taiwan CDMO warehouse scenario: a customer calls to report that the outer carton of the injectable they received is dented, but the inner packaging is intact and the product is undamaged.

blocks.zh: 分類判斷：這是配送投訴（外包裝損壞屬物流問題），不需立即通知製造商。應調查：是裝箱時壓壞？運輸途中撞擊？還是客戶端卸貨造成？
blocks.en: Classification: This is a distribution complaint (damaged outer packaging is a logistics issue), so there is no need to notify the manufacturer immediately. Investigate whether the carton was crushed during packing, knocked in transit, or damaged during unloading at the customer site.

blocks.zh: 若客戶同時說「藥液顏色似乎偏黃」，則升級為品質投訴，立即凍結相關批次並通知 MAH。兩件事要分開建檔，分開處理。
blocks.en: If the customer also says "the solution seems a bit yellow", the case escalates to a quality complaint: immediately place the batch concerned on hold and notify the MAH. The two issues must be logged and handled separately.

blocks.zh: 一位醫院藥師投訴說收到的胰島素注射劑比預期早兩週到期，這屬於品質投訴還是配送投訴？理由為何？
blocks.en: A hospital pharmacist complains that the insulin injection they received expires two weeks earlier than expected. Is this a quality complaint or a distribution complaint? Why?

blocks.zh: 你調查投訴後發現根本原因是揀貨錯誤（FIFO 未確實執行），應如何設計 CAPA？需通知主管機關嗎？
blocks.en: After investigating a complaint you find the root cause was a picking error (FIFO not properly applied). How would you design the CAPA? Does the competent authority need to be notified?

blocks.zh: 6.3 退貨管理 Returned Medicinal Products
blocks.en: 6.3 Returned Medicinal Products

blocks.zh: 退貨重回銷售庫存的四道門檻 (§6.3.2)：任何一項未達標，產品就不得重回銷售庫存，只能隔離等待處置。
blocks.en: The four gates for returning a product to saleable stock (§6.3.2): If any one is not met, the product must not go back to saleable stock and can only be segregated pending disposition.

blocks.zh: 條件 (i)：外觀完整、未到期、未被召回
blocks.en: Condition (i): intact, not expired and not recalled

blocks.zh: 條件 (ii)：非授權批發商或藥局的退貨，須在合理時限內（例如 10 天）辦理
blocks.en: Condition (ii): for returns from parties other than authorised wholesalers or pharmacies, the return must be handled within an acceptable time limit (for example 10 days)

blocks.zh: 條件 (iii)：客戶需舉證在其保管期間的儲存合規性
blocks.en: Condition (iii): the customer must demonstrate that storage during their custody was compliant

blocks.zh: 條件 (iv)：經授權人員評估，且有原始供貨證明，且無偽造疑慮
blocks.en: Condition (iv): assessed by an authorised person, with proof of the original supply and no suspicion of falsification

blocks.zh: 冷鏈產品的七點溫度證據鏈 (§6.3.3)：這是冷鏈退貨的核心。從出貨到退回倉庫，七個環節都需要書面溫度記錄，任何一環出現偏差就必須進行風險評估 (risk assessment) 才能決定是否回庫。
blocks.en: The seven-point temperature evidence chain for cold-chain products (§6.3.3): This is the core of cold-chain returns. From shipment to return to the warehouse, written temperature records are needed at seven points, and any deviation at any point requires a risk assessment before a decision can be made on returning the product to stock.

blocks.zh: FEFO (First Expired First Out，先到期先出)：退貨回庫後不能直接放在任何位置——必須按效期重新排序，確保先到期的產品先出庫，避免產品過期。
blocks.en: FEFO (First Expired First Out): After a return is put back into stock, it cannot simply go into any location. It must be re-sequenced by expiry date so that the earliest-expiring product ships first and does not expire in stock.

blocks.zh: 把退貨的冷凍魚想像成退貨的冷藏藥品：超市收到顧客退回的冷凍魚，在決定是否重新上架前，必須確認：
blocks.en: Think of a returned frozen fish as a returned cold-chain medicine. When a supermarket receives a frozen fish back from a customer, before putting it back on the shelf it must confirm:

blocks.zh: 包裝沒破（外觀完整）
blocks.en: The packaging is not broken (intact appearance)

blocks.zh: 顧客能證明這條魚在他家冰箱裡全程 -18°C（儲存合規性）
blocks.en: The customer can prove the fish stayed at -18°C in their freezer the whole time (storage compliance)

blocks.zh: 是今天早上才買的，不是三週前的（時限）
blocks.en: It was bought this morning, not three weeks ago (time limit)

blocks.zh: 這魚確實是從這家超市買的（原始供貨證明）
blocks.en: The fish was indeed bought from this supermarket (proof of original supply)

blocks.zh: 藥品的要求邏輯完全相同，只是標準更嚴格。台灣夏季氣溫高達 35°C，冷鏈退貨的溫度完整性尤其是高風險項目。
blocks.en: The logic for medicines is exactly the same, only with stricter standards. Summer temperatures in Taiwan reach 35°C, so the temperature integrity of cold-chain returns is a particularly high-risk item.

blocks.zh: 舉證責任在客戶端（§6.3.2.iii & 6.3.3）：「demonstrated by the customer」明確規定，是客戶需要提供儲存合規的證明，而非批發商假設客戶合規。若客戶無法提供，退貨不得回庫，即使產品看起來沒問題。
blocks.en: The burden of proof lies with the customer (§6.3.2.iii & 6.3.3): "Demonstrated by the customer" clearly states that the customer must provide proof of compliant storage; the wholesaler cannot simply assume the customer complied. If the customer cannot provide it, the return must not go back to stock, even if the product looks fine.

blocks.zh: 被竊後尋回的產品（§6.3.5）絕對禁止回庫：這是無例外的規定。被竊產品的保管鏈 (chain of custody) 已中斷，無法排除遭竄改或儲存條件不當的可能性，永遠不能重回銷售庫存。
blocks.en: Products recovered after theft (§6.3.5) must never be returned to stock: This rule has no exceptions. The chain of custody of a stolen product has been broken, tampering or inappropriate storage conditions cannot be ruled out, and it can never return to saleable stock.

blocks.zh: 風險評估不等於通過：§6.3.3 中，溫度偏差後的風險評估是「決策工具」，不是「放行通道」。評估結果可能是「無法放行，予以銷毀」。
blocks.en: A risk assessment is not an approval: In §6.3.3, the risk assessment after a temperature deviation is a "decision tool", not a "release route". The outcome may well be "cannot be released, destroy".

blocks.zh: 情境：醫院藥局退回一批需 2-8°C 儲存的生物製劑，距出貨日已 7 天。客戶提供了他們冰箱的連續溫度記錄（logger 數據），顯示全程 3-6°C。但藥局沒有辦理批發藥商許可。
blocks.en: Scenario: A hospital pharmacy returns a batch of biologics that require 2-8°C storage, 7 days after shipment. The customer provides continuous temperature records (logger data) from their refrigerator showing 3-6°C throughout. However, the pharmacy does not hold a wholesale dealer licence.

blocks.zh: 決策流程：
blocks.en: Decision flow:

blocks.zh: 確認外包裝完整、未到期、未召回 ✓
blocks.en: Confirm the outer packaging is intact, the product is not expired and not recalled ✓

blocks.zh: 7 天是否在「acceptable time limit」內？→ 需依公司 SOP 定義（PE011 建議例如 10 天）✓
blocks.en: Is 7 days within the "acceptable time limit"? → To be defined in the company SOP (PE011 suggests, for example, 10 days) ✓

blocks.zh: 客戶提供了溫度 logger 數據 ✓（這是 §6.3.3 要求的證據之一）
blocks.en: The customer provided temperature logger data ✓ (this is one of the items of evidence required by §6.3.3)

blocks.zh: 確認原始出貨單據、發票號碼配對 ✓
blocks.en: Confirm the original delivery note and invoice number match ✓

blocks.zh: 授權人員評估七點溫度證據鏈（含取件運輸溫度記錄）
blocks.en: The authorised person assesses the seven-point temperature evidence chain (including the temperature record of the return transport)

blocks.zh: 全部確認後方可重回冷藏庫，並依 FEFO 重新排位
blocks.en: Only after everything is confirmed may the product go back into the cold store, re-positioned according to FEFO

blocks.zh: 缺少任一環節文件，即退回隔離區等候品保決定。
blocks.en: If the documentation for any one point is missing, the product goes back to the quarantine area to await a QA decision.

blocks.zh: 客戶退回的常溫藥品外包裝有水漬，但內層鋁箔完整。依 §6.3.2(i)，你的初步判斷是什麼？需要哪些後續步驟？
blocks.en: A customer returns an ambient-temperature medicine whose outer packaging has water stains, but the inner foil is intact. Under §6.3.2(i), what is your initial judgement? What follow-up steps are needed?

blocks.zh: 倉庫人員將退貨回庫的產品直接放在貨架最後方（FEFO 未執行）。這違反了哪條規定？可能的後果是什麼？
blocks.en: A warehouse operator puts a returned product straight at the back of the shelf (FEFO not applied). Which requirement does this breach, and what could the consequences be?

blocks.zh: 一批曾被竊、後來警方尋回的產品，製造商希望你幫忙退回市場銷售。你的合規立場是什麼？依據為何？
blocks.en: A batch that was stolen and later recovered by the police is one the manufacturer wants you to help return to the market. What is your compliance position, and on what basis?

blocks.zh: 6.4 偽造藥品管理 Falsified Medicinal Products
blocks.en: 6.4 Falsified Medicinal Products

blocks.zh: 四步驟應對偽造藥品：
blocks.en: Four steps in responding to falsified medicinal products:

blocks.zh: 立即暫停銷售/配送（§6.4.1）：「疑似」就已足夠觸發，不需等確認
blocks.en: Immediately suspend sale/distribution (§6.4.1): "Suspected" is enough to trigger this; there is no need to wait for confirmation

blocks.zh: 立即通報 TFDA 及 MAH（§6.4.2）：兩者必須同時通知，且必須有書面程序（SOP）支撐
blocks.en: Immediately notify TFDA and the MAH (§6.4.2): both must be notified at the same time, supported by a written procedure (SOP)

blocks.zh: 實體隔離 + 標示（§6.4.3）：專用區域，明確標示，所有相關活動一律記錄
blocks.en: Physical segregation + labelling (§6.4.3): a dedicated area, clearly labelled, with all related activities recorded

blocks.zh: 確認後正式下市 + 留樣 + 銷毀安排（§6.4.4）：確保偽藥不重回供應鏈，留存必要樣品供法規/司法需求
blocks.en: After confirmation, formal withdrawal + retained samples + destruction arrangements (§6.4.4): ensure the falsified product does not return to the supply chain, and keep the necessary samples for regulatory or judicial needs

blocks.zh: Marketing Authorisation Holder (MAH，藥品許可證持有人)：MAH 是法律上對藥品品質和安全負最終責任的主體，批發商發現疑似偽藥必須通知，因為 MAH 掌握產品真偽鑑別的最直接能力。
blocks.en: Marketing Authorisation Holder (MAH): The MAH is the legal entity ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of the medicinal product. A wholesaler that finds a suspected falsified product must notify it, because the MAH is best placed to authenticate the product.

blocks.zh: 把偽造藥品想像成倉庫裡突然發現的爆裂物：你不需要等炸彈鑑識專家確認才疏散——「疑似」就立即行動（暫停銷售）、隔離區域（專用隔離空間）、通報警方和管理單位（TFDA + MAH）。確認後由主管機關指示後續處置。
blocks.en: Think of a falsified medicine as an explosive device suddenly found in the warehouse: you do not wait for a bomb disposal expert to confirm before evacuating. On "suspicion" you act immediately (stop sales), cordon off the area (dedicated segregation space) and notify the police and the authorities (TFDA + MAH). After confirmation, the competent authority directs what happens next.

blocks.zh: 時間就是關鍵：偽藥在市場上每多流通一天，風險就增加一天。速度優先於完美程序。
blocks.en: Time is critical: every extra day a falsified medicine stays on the market adds risk. Speed takes priority over a perfect procedure.

blocks.zh: 「疑似」就觸發行動，不等確認：§6.4.1 用的是 "suspected"（疑似），不是 "confirmed"（確認）。這是 GDP 的重要設計——寧可錯殺一批好貨，也不能讓偽藥多流通一小時。
blocks.en: "Suspected" triggers action without waiting for confirmation: §6.4.1 uses "suspected", not "confirmed". This is an important GDP design choice: better to wrongly hold a good batch than to let a falsified product circulate for one more hour.

blocks.zh: 禁止自行處置，等待主管機關指示：§6.4.2 明確要求「act on the instructions as specified by the competent authority」，批發商不能自行決定銷毀偽藥，必須等待 TFDA 的指示，因為樣品可能需要留供司法使用。
blocks.en: No disposal on your own; wait for the competent authority's instructions: §6.4.2 explicitly requires you to "act on the instructions as specified by the competent authority". A wholesaler cannot decide on its own to destroy falsified product and must wait for TFDA's instructions, because the samples may be needed for judicial use.

blocks.zh: 標示 (labelling) 要明確：「appropriately labelled」在實務上意指清楚的隔離標籤（如：QUARANTINE - SUSPECTED FALSIFIED），避免倉管人員誤取誤發。
blocks.en: Labelling must be clear: "Appropriately labelled" in practice means a clear segregation label (for example QUARANTINE - SUSPECTED FALSIFIED), so that warehouse staff do not pick or issue the product by mistake.

blocks.zh: 情境：倉管人員在例行收貨驗收時，發現一批注射劑的藥瓶標籤印刷品質異常（字體模糊、批號格式與往常不同），懷疑是偽造品。
blocks.en: Scenario: During routine goods-in inspection, a warehouse operator notices abnormal label print quality on the vials of an injectable batch (blurred fonts, batch number format different from usual) and suspects falsification.

blocks.zh: 立即行動清單（依 §6.4）：
blocks.en: Immediate action list (per §6.4):

blocks.zh: 不接收該批貨物，或若已入庫，立即停止任何銷售/揀貨指令
blocks.en: Do not accept the consignment, or if it has already been put into stock, immediately stop any sales/picking orders

blocks.zh: 將可疑品移至專用隔離區（與一般退貨隔離區也要分開），貼上明確的疑似偽藥隔離標籤
blocks.en: Move the suspect product to a dedicated quarantine area (separate from the general returns quarantine area too) and apply a clear suspected-falsified quarantine label

blocks.zh: 立即通知品保主管，由品保主管啟動 SOP
blocks.en: Immediately notify the QA manager, who activates the SOP

blocks.zh: 品保主管同時通報 TFDA（食藥署）及 MAH（藥品許可證持有人）
blocks.en: The QA manager notifies both TFDA (Taiwan Food and Drug Administration) and the MAH (marketing authorisation holder)

blocks.zh: 記錄所有操作：誰發現、何時、哪批、現場狀況描述、照片
blocks.en: Record every action: who found it, when, which batch, a description of the situation on site, and photographs

blocks.zh: 等待 TFDA 指示後，依指示辦理（留樣、回收、銷毀等）
blocks.en: After TFDA gives its instructions, proceed as instructed (retained samples, return, destruction, etc.)

blocks.zh: 你收到的一批貨物中，有 5% 數量（共 10 支）標籤異常，其餘 95% 看起來正常。你應該只隔離那 10 支，還是整批？理由為何？
blocks.en: In a consignment you received, 5% of the quantity (10 units in total) has abnormal labels and the other 95% looks normal. Should you segregate only those 10 units or the whole batch? Why?

blocks.zh: 供應商打來電話說「那批貨是印刷廠換紙造成的正常差異，不是偽藥」，你是否可以依此說法解除隔離？依據 §6.4 的正確做法是什麼？
blocks.en: The supplier phones to say "that batch is a normal variation caused by the printer changing paper stock, not a falsified product". Can you release the quarantine on that basis? What is the correct approach under §6.4?

blocks.zh: 6.5 藥品召回 Medicinal Product Recalls
blocks.en: 6.5 Medicinal Product Recalls

blocks.zh: 召回的三個系統性要求：
blocks.en: Three systemic requirements for recalls:

blocks.zh: 可追溯性 (traceability)：§6.5.1 和 §6.5.8 要求發貨紀錄必須詳細到能追出「哪批貨發給了哪些客戶」，包含非上班時間的聯絡電話
blocks.en: Traceability: §6.5.1 and §6.5.8 require distribution records detailed enough to trace which batch went to which customers, including contact telephone numbers outside working hours

blocks.zh: 隨時可啟動 (§6.5.5)：召回能力不能是週一至週五上班時間限定——凌晨三點收到召回通知，也要能啟動作業
blocks.en: Able to start at any time (§6.5.5): recall capability cannot be limited to Monday-to-Friday office hours. If a recall notice arrives at 3 a.m., you must still be able to start the operation

blocks.zh: 年度有效性評估 (§6.5.4)：至少每年進行一次模擬召回 (mock recall) 或演練，以驗證召回程序的有效性
blocks.en: Annual effectiveness evaluation (§6.5.4): carry out a mock recall or exercise at least once a year to verify the effectiveness of the recall procedure

blocks.zh: 召回最終報告與對帳 (reconciliation)：§6.5.9 要求的對帳，是指「發出多少 vs. 收回多少」必須有文件說明差異原因。完整的數量對帳是主管機關評估召回有效性的核心指標。
blocks.en: Final recall report and reconciliation: The reconciliation required by §6.5.9 means that "quantity sent out vs. quantity recovered" must be documented, with reasons given for any difference. Complete quantity reconciliation is a core indicator the competent authority uses to assess the effectiveness of a recall.

blocks.zh: 想像召回是軍事動員令：平時（§6.5.1 可追溯性）就要有完整的人員清冊（客戶資料）；動員令一下（召回通知），必須在最短時間內聯繫到所有人（§6.5.2 清晰可行動的指示）；動員結束後要有點名報告（§6.5.9 最終報告與對帳）。
blocks.en: Think of a recall as a military mobilisation order: in peacetime (§6.5.1 traceability) you must already hold a complete roster of personnel (customer data); when the order comes (the recall notice), you must reach everyone in the shortest possible time (§6.5.2 clear, actionable instructions); and when it ends you need a roll-call report (§6.5.9 final report and reconciliation).

blocks.zh: §6.5.4 的「年度演練」就是平時的動員演習——確保真正需要時，不會因為程序不熟悉或聯絡資料過期而失敗。
blocks.en: The "annual exercise" in §6.5.4 is the peacetime mobilisation drill. It makes sure that when it is really needed, the recall does not fail because the procedure is unfamiliar or the contact data are out of date.

blocks.zh: 「非上班時間聯絡電話」是硬性要求（§6.5.8）：Distribution records 中必須包含客戶的「inside and outside working hours」電話。若客戶清單只有辦公室電話，深夜發生召回時無法聯繫，這是稽查缺失。
blocks.en: "Out-of-hours contact numbers" are a hard requirement (§6.5.8): Distribution records must include customers' telephone numbers "inside and outside working hours". If the customer list holds only office numbers, you cannot reach anyone when a recall happens late at night, and this is an audit deficiency.

blocks.zh: 出口產品的召回通知義務（§6.5.3）：若產品已出口，必須依國內法規通知海外對口單位和當地主管機關。台灣 CDMO 若有出口業務，必須在 SOP 中明確這一流程。
blocks.en: Recall notification obligations for exported products (§6.5.3): If a product has been exported, overseas counterparts and local competent authorities must be notified in accordance with national legislation. A Taiwan CDMO with export business must set out this process clearly in its SOP.

blocks.zh: 召回訊息的核准（§6.5.6）：批發商必須「依照召回通知執行」，不能自行修改召回範圍或指示。若主管機關要求事前核准召回通知，必須取得核准後再發送。
blocks.en: Approval of recall messages (§6.5.6): The wholesaler must act "in accordance with the recall notice" and cannot modify the recall scope or instructions on its own. If the competent authority requires prior approval of the recall notice, approval must be obtained before it is sent out.

blocks.zh: 實時記錄（§6.5.7）："recorded at the time it is carried out" 意味著召回過程的記錄不能事後補寫——必須即時記錄，包含時間戳記。
blocks.en: Real-time recording (§6.5.7): "Recorded at the time it is carried out" means recall records cannot be written up after the fact. They must be made contemporaneously, with timestamps.

blocks.zh: 模擬召回演練設計（針對 Taiwan CDMO 倉儲）：
blocks.en: Designing a mock recall exercise (for a Taiwan CDMO warehouse):

blocks.zh: 每年至少一次，選定一個已出貨的批號，模擬執行以下流程：
blocks.en: At least once a year, select a batch that has already been shipped and simulate the following steps:

blocks.zh: 可追溯性測試：從批號出發，在 2 小時內找出所有客戶清單及發貨數量
blocks.en: Traceability test: starting from the batch number, produce the list of all customers and quantities shipped within 2 hours

blocks.zh: 聯絡能力測試：若在非上班時間發生，能否在 4 小時內聯繫到所有直接客戶？
blocks.en: Contactability test: if it happened outside working hours, could you reach all direct customers within 4 hours?

blocks.zh: 庫存對帳：尚未出貨或已回庫的數量 + 客戶確認收回數量，應等於原始出貨量
blocks.en: Stock reconciliation: the quantity not yet shipped or already returned to stock + the quantity customers confirm as recovered should equal the original quantity shipped

blocks.zh: 文件記錄：演練全程實時記錄，結束後產出演練報告，記載問題點與改善行動
blocks.en: Documentation: record the whole exercise in real time and, at the end, produce an exercise report documenting the problems found and improvement actions

blocks.zh: 演練結果若發現客戶聯絡資料過期、批次追溯超過時限，或客戶清單不完整，均為需要 CAPA 的缺失。
blocks.en: If the exercise finds outdated customer contact data, batch tracing that exceeds the time limit, or an incomplete customer list, each of these is a deficiency requiring CAPA.

blocks.zh: 你的配送紀錄顯示某批號共發出 1000 支，召回後客戶回收了 820 支，庫存中找到 50 支。還有 130 支無法交代。依 §6.5.9 的對帳要求，你的最終報告應如何處理這 130 支的差異？
blocks.en: Your distribution records show that 1000 units of a batch were shipped. After the recall, customers returned 820 units and 50 units were found in stock. 130 units remain unaccounted for. Under the reconciliation requirement in §6.5.9, how should your final report handle the 130-unit difference?

blocks.zh: 某個週六凌晨收到 MAH 發出的第二級召回 (Class II recall) 通知，要求 24 小時內通知所有客戶。你的公司 SOP 是否應該涵蓋非上班時間的召回啟動程序？依 §6.5.5 的理由是什麼？
blocks.en: On a Saturday at dawn you receive a Class II recall notice from the MAH, requiring all customers to be notified within 24 hours. Should your company SOP cover recall initiation outside working hours? What is the reasoning under §6.5.5?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 §6.5.4 要求「至少每年」評估召回有效性，而不是「發生過召回後再評估」？
blocks.en: Why does §6.5.4 require recall effectiveness to be evaluated "at least annually", rather than only after a recall has occurred?

blocks.zh: 章節總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: PIC/S PE 011-1 第六章為 GDP 中最具實務操作性的章節，涵蓋四類高風險事件的管理要求：
blocks.en: PIC/S PE 011-1 Chapter 6 is the most operationally practical chapter of GDP, covering management requirements for four high-risk event types:

blocks.zh: 6.1 原則：所有四類事件均須有書面程序、完整紀錄、指定人員，且供應鏈各環節需一致應對
blocks.en: 6.1 Principle: all four event types require written procedures, complete records and designated personnel, and every link of the supply chain must respond consistently

blocks.zh: 6.2 投訴：區分品質投訴（立即通知 MAH）與配送投訴（自行調查）；必須有指定投訴負責人；調查後視需要執行 CAPA
blocks.en: 6.2 Complaints: distinguish quality complaints (notify the MAH immediately) from distribution complaints (investigate yourself); a designated complaint handler is required; implement CAPA after investigation where needed

blocks.zh: 6.3 退貨：回庫需同時滿足四項條件；冷鏈產品需要七點溫度證據鏈；偷竊後尋回的產品絕對禁止回庫；回庫後依 FEFO 排位
blocks.en: 6.3 Returns: all four conditions must be met before return to stock; cold-chain products need the seven-point temperature evidence chain; products recovered after theft must never be returned to stock; position returned stock according to FEFO

blocks.zh: 6.4 偽藥：疑似即暫停→立即通報 TFDA 及 MAH→實體隔離並標示→確認後依主管機關指示下市銷毀，留存必要樣品
blocks.en: 6.4 Falsified medicines: suspicion alone means stop sales → immediately notify TFDA and the MAH → physically segregate and label → after confirmation, withdraw and destroy as directed by the competent authority, keeping the necessary samples

blocks.zh: 6.5 召回：可追溯性是召回成功的基礎；隨時可啟動；通報義務含海外；至少每年演練評估；最終報告需包含數量對帳
blocks.en: 6.5 Recalls: traceability is the foundation of a successful recall; be able to start at any time; notification obligations extend overseas; exercise and evaluate at least annually; the final report must include quantity reconciliation

blocks.zh: 在 Taiwan CDMO 情境下，這四類事件管理直接影響客戶信任、TFDA 稽查結果與法律責任。建立清晰的 SOP、維護完整的配送紀錄（含客戶非上班時間聯絡方式），以及每年執行模擬召回演練，是合規的最低基線。
blocks.en: In a Taiwan CDMO setting, managing these four event types directly affects customer trust, TFDA inspection outcomes and legal liability. Clear SOPs, complete distribution records (including customers' out-of-hours contact details) and an annual mock recall exercise are the minimum baseline for compliance.
